title: Common
description: Shared definitions referenced by every other contract (spec Part C1). Reference them as `common.schema.json#/definitions/<Name>`.

SpeechLocale.description: Speech locale. Speech engines take language-REGION codes, so Hinglish (hi-Latn on screen) is spoken as hi-IN.

Audience.description: Who may see a payload: a surface never renders content for an audience it does not serve.

Tier.description: Risk tier of a command (spec Part C6).

PrefixedId.description: A ULID prefixed by its kind, e.g. bill_01JBQ0Z7Y8K3M4N5P6Q7R8S9T1 (spec Part C1).

DottedCode.description: A stable dotted code such as an event topic (clock.ticked) or an error code (policy.quiet_hours).

MessageKey.description: An i18n message key: two or more dot-separated segments, e.g. chip.aaj_kitna_aaya.
